The brief

A dental clinic in Milton with a modern website, local SEO and a steady stream of patient-friendly social videos. The goal was a website that loads fast, explains every service clearly and turns local searches into calls and bookings.

What I did

  • Website development and ongoing updates on Next.js.
  • Keyword research and on-page SEO for the main service pages: titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links.
  • Technical SEO: indexing checks, site speed and structured data (schema markup).
  • Local SEO: location-focused content and local citations for Milton, Ontario, Canada.

Highlights

  • Dentist schema with the clinic's full address
  • Services, about, blog and contact pages
  • Patient education reels, including insurance-benefit and nervous-patient videos
